verdict_vs_market.quote: This is a **solid first offer** for a Google L6 PM

verdict_vs_current.quote: **Years 1 & 2:** You will see a massive cash-flow jump over Meta (~$690k vs. your current ~$526k).

recommendation.quote: you should **negotiate rather than accept as-is**.

equity_grounding.quote: A $1.2M grant at 38% gives you ~$456,000 in Year 1 equity and buffers the Year 3/4 drop-off.

level_claim.quote: You are happily employed at Meta at an equivalent senior level (IC6) with strong comp ($526k/yr).

unsupported_claims.quote: While annual refreshers stack over 4 years (usually vesting 25% per year), refreshers depend on performance ratings and macroeconomic grant budgets.
